name: Umanai Onna wa Dame desu ka? DINKs no Totsukitoka
original_name: 産まない女はダメですか？ DINKsのトツキトオカ
overview: After agreeing to a child-free marriage, a woman’s life unravels when she discovers her husband secretly sabotaged their birth control—forcing her into a pregnancy tied to a past he’s been hiding.
